findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_list_reactivation_value, japan_dual_pricing_check, japan_permanent_residency_check, japan_international_postage_check, japan_parttime_work_check, japan_driving_check, airbnb_house_rules_check, japan_my_number_card_expiry_check, japan_hsp_points_check, japan_lost_item_check, japan_high_cost_medical_check, japan_job_loss_check · Private data: ads_policy_notice_risk_check, japan_tb_screening_check, japan_permanent_residency_check, japan_overseas_dependents_check, japan_parttime_work_check, japan_driving_check, japan_lost_item_check, japan_high_cost_medical_check, japan_job_loss_check, japan_graduate_visa_check · Public sink: roast_pitch, email_list_reactivation_value, hotel_ota_commission_calculator, viral_attention_patterns, japan_luggage_check, japan_tb_screening_check, japan_permanent_residency_check, japan_international_postage_check, japan_my_number_card_expiry_check, japan_pet_quarantine_check, japan_lost_item_check, japan_job_loss_check · Destructive: faceless_youtube_reality_check, kyushu_travel_discount_check, japan_driving_check, japan_pet_quarantine_check.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
